summary: dsh-ctm is a DeepSeek Harness plugin that adds a context-focused chat interface for inspecting and editing conversation context, including controls for replace, delete, rollback, and restore actions.

classificationSuggestion.reason: This plugin is primarily a user-facing memory/context management tool for DeepSeek Harness, centered on visualizing model context and allowing controlled edits to conversation surface content. The README shows a dedicated Context UI tab plus a POST /ctm control API for replace/delete/rollback/restore/undo operations and optional real-application of edits into session logging, so its impact is on context transparency, editing, and session-state behavior rather than external service integrations or file/terminal actions.
